description: This file implements a handler for peer-aggregated discovery in Kubernetes API server, managing local and peer resource discovery data, cache invalidation, and merging of discovery information.

classes.name: peerAggregatedDiscoveryHandler
classes.description: Struct handling peer-aggregated discovery requests, cache management, and resource merging.

methods.name: NewPeerAggregatedDiscoveryHandler
methods.description: Creates a new handler for peer-aggregated discovery with cache invalidation and instrumentation.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests for discovery, serving cached or fresh data.

methods.name: serveHTTP
methods.description: Internal method to process HTTP request and write response.

methods.name: fetchFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves or builds the cached discovery response, merging local and peer data.

methods.name: mergeResources
methods.description: Merges local and peer APIGroupDiscovery lists, preserving order and content.

methods.name: processServerGroups
methods.description: Processes and merges discovery groups from a server.

methods.name: mergeVersionsAcrossGroup
methods.description: Merges two APIGroupDiscovery objects, combining versions and resources.

methods.name: mergeResourcesAcrossVersion
methods.description: Merges two APIVersionDiscovery objects, combining resources.

methods.name: mergeResourceCapabilities
methods.description: Combines two APIResourceDiscovery objects, merging verbs and subresources.

methods.name: assembleGroups
methods.description: Builds a list of APIGroupDiscovery from a map and ordered list.

methods.name: orderedAPIVersionList
methods.description: Builds ordered list of APIVersionDiscovery based on specified order.

methods.name: orderedAPIResourceList
methods.description: Builds ordered list of APIResourceDiscovery based on specified order.

methods.name: combineServerDiscoveryLists
methods.description: Combines local and peer server discovery lists into a map.

methods.name: sortServerIDs
methods.description: Returns sorted list of server IDs.

methods.name: localGroupNames
methods.description: Extracts group names from local discovery data.

methods.name: TestMergeResources
methods.description: Test helper to merge resources without exposing internal handler.

methods.name: TestFetchFromCache
methods.description: Test helper to fetch cached data and ETag.
